Docs/Getting started/Integration guide

Developer docs

Ship usage-based billing without rebuilding your product stack.

PulseKit gives early-stage teams metering, customer portals, and lifecycle webhooks through one API.

Install the SDK

Use the server SDK to create meters and report usage from trusted environments.

# npm
npm install @pulsekit/server
Private beta

Use your workspace token from Settings > API keys. Tokens are scoped by environment.

Configure a meter

Meters define what you count and how late-arriving events are handled.

const pulse = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.PULSEKIT_KEY });
await pulse.meters.create({ name: "ai_tokens", aggregation: "sum" });
Production checklist

Send idempotency keys for imported backfill jobs and webhook retries.

Tabbed code examples

await pulse.usage.record({ customerId, value: 42 });
PulseKit::Usage.record(customer_id: customer_id, value: 42)

Webhooks

Listen for subscription state changes and entitlement updates.

EventWhen it fires
invoice.finalizedAfter billing calculations complete.
entitlement.changedWhen a customer upgrades, downgrades, or expires.

Rate limits

Batch imports may send up to 1,000 events per request. Interactive API calls are limited per workspace.
